import { Aside } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

<Aside type="note" title="Paths updated to current layout">
Several paths in the original table moved. The live operator now lives in
`packages/operator-core` (served via the Hono host on `:3070` + the Vite
SPA `@papercusp/operator-vite` on `:3055`; the standalone Next webapp is
retired). The plugin SDK/loader are `@papercusp/plugin-sdk` /
`@papercusp/plugin-loader`. The `marketplace-api`/`marketplace-site` apps
were removed (distribution is now the Cupboard, `apps/operator-public`),
and the `apps/papercup` reference install is retired to `_retired/papercup/`.
</Aside>

        <thead><tr><th>Path</th><th>Contains</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>`libs/papercusp/packages/harness`</td><td>The substrate: blueprint prompts (`blueprints/*/prompts/`), role/identity templates (`identity/`), and `bin/` scripts (e.g. `bin/supervisor.sh`). Iterations boot from the per-blueprint DBOS/director pipeline — the standalone `run.sh` run-loop is retired.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>`libs/papercusp/packages/harness/blueprints/coding`</td><td>The POT/Mug blueprint (`id: coding`, `kind: 'pot'`) — the minimal single-role operator that surveys the blackboard and decides its own next wake. The judgment layer over the fleet.</td></tr>
          <tr><td>`libs/papercusp/packages/harness/blueprints/coding-factory`</td><td>The default coding harness (`id: coding-factory`) — a per-feature director driving scoper &rarr; architect &rarr; worker &rarr; validator &rarr; reviewer &rarr; documenter &rarr; curator, with opt-in quality gates (tester / security / crosscheck / ui-qa).</td></tr>
          <tr><td>`packages/plugin-sdk` (`@papercusp/plugin-sdk`)</td><td>TypeScript types for plugin authors. `PapercuspPlugin`, `UiContribution`, `Capability`, etc.</td></tr>
